A battery charger and a white battery are visible in the background.

Photo 1: Rear view of the camera showing the LCD screen, menu buttons (MENU, INFO), and the mode dial. The lens is attached. A second lens is visible to the right. A battery charger and a white battery are on the table.

Photo 2: Top view of the camera from a slightly different angle, showing the mode dial, lens, and battery charger. The lens has 'Canon' and 'IMAGE STABILIZER' visible. The camera body shows signs of use and dust.
All photos show the camera and accessories on a red, scratched plastic surface with white lettering (partially visible).
No visible damage to the camera body or lens in the photos, but the lens appears dusty and used.
